dcterms:title: World Bank Data Catalogue
dcterms:description: The Data Catalog is designed to make World Bank's development data easy to find, download, use, and share. It includes data from the World Bank's microdata, finances and energy data platforms, as well as datasets from the open data catalog.

dcterms:title: Eurostat
dcterms:description: High-quality statistics and data on Europe.

dcterms:title: UNdata
dcterms:description: UNdata brings international statistical databases within easy reach of users through a single-entry point. Users can search and download a variety of statistical resources compiled by the United Nations (UN) statistical system and other international agencies.

dcterms:title: OECD Data
dcterms:description: The OECD Data Explorer is the organisation's data warehouse, providing access to all OECD statistical data.  It is the entry point for figures on a wide range of statistical topics, covering OECD member countries and partner economies.

dcterms:title: UNICEF Data
dcterms:description: Leads the collection, validation, analysis, use and communication of the most statistically sound, internationally comparable data on the situation of children and women around the world.

dcterms:title: UNESCO Institute for Statistics
dcterms:description: Source of internationally comparable data on education, science, culture and communication. The official statistical agency of UNESCO, and the custodian agency for Sustainable Development Goal 4 on Education.

dcterms:title: UNOPS Data Portal
dcterms:description: A platform that provides users with dynamic and linked information about UNOPS projects going back to 2018, including over 1,000 ongoing projects around the world.

dcterms:title: ASEANstats Data Portal
dcterms:description: Comprehensive overview of ASEAN's social, economic, and environment landscape.

dcterms:title: IMF Data
dcterms:description: Access to economic and financial data.

dcterms:title: Harvard Dataverse
dcterms:description: An open source web application for sharing, preserving, citing, exploring, and analyzing research data.

dcterms:title: Open Africa
dcterms:description: Aims to be the largest independent repository of open data on the African continent.

dcterms:title: UN SDG Indicators Database
dcterms:description: Access to data on more than 210 SDG indicators for countries, areas or regions across the globe.

dcterms:title: UK Office for National Statistics
dcterms:description: The ONS is the UK’s largest independent producer of official statistics and the country’s recognised national statistical institute.

dcterms:title: UK National Data Library
dcterms:description: The National Data Library is the UK government’s central service for finding and using public-sector data.

dcterms:title: Data.gov
dcterms:description: The United States Government’s open-data site. Publishes government open data to inform public and policymaker decisions, stimulate innovation and economic activity, support agencies in their missions, and strengthen open and transparent government.

dcterms:title: UK Data Service
dcterms:description: The UK Data Service is the UK’s principal repository for economic, population and social research data.

dcterms:title: UK National Archives
dcterms:description: The National Archives is the official archive of the UK government and preserves the nation’s public record.

dcterms:title: Administrative Data Research UK
dcterms:description: ADR UK is a UK-wide partnership that enables public-sector administrative data to be securely linked and accessed for research.

dcterms:title: Data.gov.au
dcterms:description: Data.gov.au is the Australian Government’s national data portal, providing a central place for discovering government datasets and other public data resources.

dcterms:title: Portal Brasileiro de Dados Abertos
dcterms:description: Dados.gov.br is the Brazilian Federal Government’s Portal de Dados Abertos, providing a central catalogue and infrastructure for government organisations to publish and users to discover open datasets.

dcterms:title: Open Government Portal Canada
dcterms:description: Open.Canada.ca is the Government of Canada’s Open Government portal, bringing together open government data and information from federal and participating other jurisdictions.

dcterms:title: Open Government Data Platform India
dcterms:description: Data.gov.in is India’s Open Government Data (OGD) Platform, a Government of India/Digital India initiative through which ministries and departments publish government datasets.

dcterms:title: Singapore's open data portal
dcterms:description: Data.gov.sg is Singapore’s open government data platform.

dcterms:title: Das Datenportal für Deutschland
dcterms:description: GovData is Germany’s data portal, providing a single central point of access to administrative data from federal, state and municipal levels of government as well as other public-sector sources.

dcterms:title: Open data van de Overheid
dcterms:description: Data.overheid.nl is the National Data Portal of the Dutch government, describing and providing access to Dutch government data, including both open and restricted datasets.

dcterms:title: Datos Abiertos del Gobierno de España
dcterms:description: Datos.gob.es is Spain’s national open-data initiative and platform, bringing together the national catalogue of open datasets as well as guidance, learning materials and information about data and reuse.

dcterms:title: Портал открытых данных Российской Федерации
dcterms:description: The Open Data Portal of the Russian Federation is a comprehensive government system that ensures open information on the activities of government bodies and provides centralized access to open government information resources to all citizens and organizations.

dcterms:title: International Labour Organisation
dcterms:description: The Statistics Branch of the ILO Department of Research and Statistics is the focal point to the United Nations on labour statistics. We develop international standards for better measurement of labour issues and enhanced international comparability; provide relevant, timely and comparable labour statistics; and help Member States develop and improve their labour statistics.
